description: Download a certificate as a file (zip of PEM files) (Certificate Manager 2.0). Pass savePath to write the file to disk; otherwise it is returned inline as base64 when it is 256 KB or smaller. Public zone only. Works with main-account and Sub Account keys (Sub Account verified 2026-11-25; earlier the 2.0 API rejected Sub Account keys with HTTP 403).

savePath.description: Local file path to save the downloaded file to (recommended)

name: ncloud_cm2_download_certificate
